about_the_game:
In 2001, you were taken. And somehow, you survived.
Over two decades later, you return to the place that should have stayed buried: Stanley’s World.

Once a cheerful drop-off nursery for children—where parents left their kids while they ran errands or went to work—it was abruptly shut down in 2001, just days after a string of mysterious disappearances... and the world changed forever.

Now it’s quiet. Empty. Almost.

🕹️ Stanley Says is a first-person puzzle horror game set in the decaying remains of a once-trusted childcare center. Piece together the twisted history of Harvey Lamon, the man behind the madness, and Stanley, the smiling mascot who never really left.

💀 Features:

  • Explore eerie environments dripping with corrupted childhood nostalgia

  • Solve dark puzzles to unlock doors, secrets, and memories long forgotten

  • Follow Stanley’s rules… or face the consequences

  • Uncover disturbing lore through notes, tapes, and objects frozen in time from 2001

“Stanley says… don’t look behind you.”

You’re not a kid anymore.
But Stanley doesn’t care.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes some depictions of blood on the floor and objects, without bodies, corpses, or any indication of its source. In a final sequence, the player character kills the antagonist, Stanley.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Lower-end systems may need to run on Low graphics settings. or Performance may vary on laptops or older hardware.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Game runs best on Medium to High settings. SSD recommended for faster load times.

short_description: A first-person puzzle horror game set in a defunct children's nursery from 2001. Uncover dark secrets, solve mascot-themed puzzles, and survive the twisted games of Stanley—an animatronic who never stopped playing.
